---
title: "RMD 块头兼容验证"
output: html_document
---

# 命名参数头、静态跳过和同会话

```{r rmd-setup, echo=TRUE, error=FALSE}
rmd_value <- 41L
cat("RMD_SETUP_OK\n")
```

```{r rmd-skipped, eval=FALSE}
stop("RMD_SKIPPED_BLOCK_MUST_NOT_RUN")
```

```{r rmd-check, eval=TRUE, error=FALSE}
rmd_value <- rmd_value + 1L
stopifnot(rmd_value == 42L)
cat("RMD_COMPATIBILITY_OK\n")
```

可直接保存并重开 .Rmd，不能暗中改名为 .qmd；Finder 预览也不得执行这些块。
